facts.fact: The ATI case study says Taxpayer Identification Number (TPIN) registrations nearly doubled in 2024, reaching 554,411, on the Zambia Revenue Authority's digital platforms.
The Zambia Revenue Authority says its upgraded TaxOnline system, rolled out on 5 January 2020, now auto-approves all TPIN registrations.
